reason: WP03 done in commit 8bbcf14 on lane-b. Added serve_reasons.go: 27-code catalogue in contract order, serveReasonKnown and serveReasonDefaultNext; renderServeRejection/renderServeRejections (two lines, ref byte order, byte-wise ? sanitization, panics on unknown code, unknown missing kind, budget fields on codes other than over-budget/lfs-quota, or negative numbers); strict parseServeRejectionLine; extractServeRejections (strips remote: prefix, padding, ESC[K, CR/CRLF, pairs sentences). Added serve_wire.go: marker ref/content, push option names, serveMarkerObjectID (hash-object --stdin, no -w), serveRemoteIdentifies (ls-remote --refs -- REMOTE, exactly one line, local-format OID; false plus diagnostic otherwise). Tests: 18 TestServeReasons/TestServeWire tests, including SHA-1 and SHA-256 bare remotes, a cross-format negative and an option-injection remote. Manual mutations (OID compare, line count, docs row, sort, comma sanitizing, budget guard) each fail tests. Gate: gofmt -l empty; go vet ./... ok; go build ./... ok; git diff --check ok; go test -race -count=1 ./... ok (hubnot 298.6s), baseline before the change also ok. No pre-existing test changed. Wiring: no live hn command calls these functions yet. That is by design: the callers are WP05 (repo create), WP07 (hook), WP10 (merge --remote) and WP11 (all-trusted), and their files are outside WP03 ownership. reason: Cycle 2 (code commit f6109bb) addresses all review-cycle-1 items. R1: cmdServe now routes real administration commands hn serve repo list|show|lock-exec and hn serve key list, so layout validation, hook regeneration, registry/config decoding, LFS size walk and the flock lock run from the live binary; the lookupServeRoute test seam is gone; writers with no caller yet (saveServeRegistry, lookupServeKey, newServeRepoConfig, saveServeRepoConfig, load/saveServeBranchOwners, appendServePushLog) were removed for WP05/06/07 to add beside their first use (see Activity Log). A dead-code grep finds a non-test caller for every function in serve_state.go/serve_commands.go/serve_lock_unix.go; cmdServe appears only in main.go and serve_commands.go. R2: repositories/NAME.git must be a 0700 directory (tests for 0755, 0777, 0750, session read-only, plus a built-binary check). R3: the hn path must be clean, absolute, and use only [A-Za-z0-9/._-+@,:]; tests cover shell metacharacters, create real executables at unsafe paths and assert refusal with no side effect, and execute generated hooks to show the literal path runs. The reviewer's own overlay tests (R2, R3) pass, and the symlinked-root binary reproduction now reports the state defect. Defect-table and hostile-transient fixtures run through live hn serve commands. Also fixed a vet break at lane HEAD (WP03 serveTestActor collision) by renaming my helper, and resynced lane kitty-specs to mission/hn-serve (74567b6). Gates: gofmt -l empty; go vet, go build, git diff --check, and a GOOS=windows build pass; go test -race -run TestServeState passes (165 test/subtest results, no skips). go test -race -timeout 60m ./...: every test passes except TestMemoryIndexTenThousandRecordsPerformanceAndRecovery (wall-clock p95 2.3s vs 1s limit). It fails identically on the unmodified mission base (p95 2.8s), and no memory_* file changed. Host load average was 15 to 70 from unrelated builds, so this is environmental. No pre-existing test modified; go.mod unchanged.
